description: Ratso seems steadied by the warmth in his hands.
He nods, sipping the soup.
Ratso hesitates, then speaks.
Ratso is embarrassed as he speaks.
Ratso says he doesn't think he can walk and that he's been falling down a lot.
Ratso says he's scared.
Ratso steps out with Joe, gesturing to the corridor...
Ratso leans heavily on the down button, glancing at Joe.
Ratso glances up the elevator shaft nervously, rings again and turns back to Joe.
Ratso is on the phone.
Ratso holds the phone and speaks into it, referring to Enrico Rizzo from the Bronx and saying the boy needs Mr. O'Daniel right now.
Ratso speaks aside to Joe, saying 'I got his tongue hanging out...'
Ratso darts into traffic against a red light, yelling unheard obscenities at a cab driver who blasts his horn.
Ratso slams the taxi fender with his fist, pretending to be hit, falling into Joe's arms.
Ratso recovers, strolls casually in front of the cab, biting his thumb at the driver.
Ratso points toward a young man with diamond cuff-links, sitting with a blue-haired matron who puffs on a small cigar.
scene_context: At the corner of Central Park South, Ratso identifies a young man to Joe.

description: Ratso waves jauntily at the young man, raising his thumb and forefinger in a circle, leaving the young man baffled as Ratso hurries Joe on.
scene_context: At the corner of Central Park South, Ratso greets a young man and then moves on quickly.
